images.title: Focused entry
images.prompt:

Small Bakery logo at top left (use the supplied bread-bot on conveyor ONLY as a tiny 28px identity mark; replace the large illustrated wordmark with simple dark Geist 'Bakery'), tiny theme control top right. Footer 'Your work keeps running while you are away.' in small muted text. Calm, familiar, operational. Thin chrome only. Crisp beautifully typeset actual readable English text. This is a direction comp, all account names and content are synthetic.
